The test image shows a soybean leaf with:
- Dark brown/purplish lesions with **yellow halos** surrounding them
- **Holes** where dead tissue has fallen out (shot-hole / ragged appearance)
- Upper leaf surface view

This strongly suggests Bacterial_Blight (yellow-green halos + dead tissue falling out) or Frogeye_leaf_spot. Let me check the reference.

The reference images for Bacterial_Blight show the early-stage small angular lesions with yellow-green halos. The test image appears to be a more advanced stage — larger dark brown/purple lesions with clear yellow halos and shot-holes where dead tissue has fallen out, which perfectly matches the Bacterial_Blight description: *"spots darken and are surrounded by yellowish-green halos... dead tissue may fall out giving leaves a ragged appearance."*

The larger lesion size suggests an advanced infection stage compared to early angular spots shown in reference images."}
